items.title: Google Completes Acquisition of Wiz in Historic $32 Billion Deal
items.description: Google has officially closed its $32 billion all-cash acquisition of Wiz, the Israeli cloud and AI security platform, marking the largest deal in Google’s history and a landmark moment for the global cybersecurity industry. The Wiz team will join Google Cloud while retaining its brand and continuing to support customers across all major cloud environments. […] The post Google Completes…
